steps.title: Filing of Complaint / FIR
steps.description: Information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence is recorded under Section 154 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

steps.title: Investigation
steps.description: Police investigate the offence, collect evidence, and record statements under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

steps.title: Arrest (If Required)
steps.description: Accused may be arrested in accordance with applicable provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

steps.title: Production Before Magistrate
steps.description: Arrested accused is produced before the Magistrate within the prescribed time for judicial oversight.

steps.title: Bail Hearing
steps.description: Court considers the bail application under applicable provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

conditional_branches.effect: Accused is released subject to conditions imposed by the court
Accused is remanded to judicial custody pending further proceedings

steps.title: Filing of Charge Sheet or Closure Report
steps.description: Upon completion of investigation, police submit either a charge sheet or a closure report to the Magistrate under Section 173 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

conditional_branches.effect: Court proceeds to examine the case for trial
Magistrate may accept the closure or direct further investigation

steps.title: Cognizance by Magistrate
steps.description: Magistrate examines the police report and takes cognizance of the offence under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

steps.title: Framing of Charges
steps.description: Court frames formal charges against the accused if sufficient grounds exist.

steps.title: Trial
steps.description: Examination of prosecution witnesses, cross-examination, defence evidence, and final arguments.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court delivers judgment of acquittal or conviction based on evidence and arguments.

steps.title: Sentencing
steps.description: If convicted, the court hears the accused on the question of sentence and passes an order.

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against conviction, acquittal, or sentence as permitted by law
Criminal appeal or revision under applicable provisions of law
Special Leave Petition or appeal as permitted by law
